test_name: Verify User Navigation to Empty Cart and Return to Store
description: This test validates the user's ability to access the cart page when it is empty and navigate back to the store using the 'Return to Shop' button.
steps: Navigate to the homepage at https://atid.store.
Click on the 'Cart' link in the main navigation menu.
Verify that the cart page loads successfully.
Assert that the empty cart message is visible on the page.
Locate and click the 'RETURN TO SHOP' button.
Verify that the user is redirected to the store page.
expected_results: User successfully navigates to the cart page.
The empty cart message is displayed.
User clicks the 'RETURN TO SHOP' button and is redirected to the store page.
edge_cases: The 'Cart' link is not clickable due to network issues.
The empty cart message fails to load due to a server error.
The 'RETURN TO SHOP' button redirects to an incorrect page.
The cart page is inaccessible due to permissions or authentication issues.
The store page fails to load after redirection.
data_requirements: User must have an empty cart state.
The 'RETURN TO SHOP' button must be enabled and functional.
The navigation menu must be visible.
The empty cart message must be configured to display correctly.
The store page must be available.
dependencies: Cart page must have proper routing configured.
Store page must be functional and accessible.
api_interactions: GET request for store page data.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the cart page.
Page load time for the store page.
accessibility_requirements: The 'RETURN TO SHOP' button should be keyboard accessible.
Empty cart message should have appropriate ARIA roles.
Navigation links should have descriptive labels.
